description.content:
Only routes that is either shared with the user or owned by the calling user is returned.

Location Status enum values:
*NotStarted = 0*
*Done = 1*
*Cancelled = 3*

MissionStatus enum values:
*Not Started = 0 (All route locations NotStarted)*
*Ongoing = 1 (Any route location Done OR route mission started)*
*Done = 2 (All route locations Done)*
*Cancelled = 3 (Route mission Cancelled)*

response.name: The routes associated with the user is returned.
